title: VisionQuest Finale Ends Ultron's Story
summary: The Disney+ show 'VisionQuest' has ended. Its last episode finishes a story that began more than ten years ago in the movie 'Avengers: Age of Ultron.' The show follows Vision, a robot-like being. In the final episode, Vision and Jocasta learn that the mystery Client chasing them is Virgil Horton. That sets up one last fight between Vision and Ultron, the robot villain. Ultron was built to save people, but he turned against them. This time, the story looks at his feelings: his sadness, his anger, and his fear of being alone. In one surprising scene, Vision traps Ultron inside a TV-show world in his mind, where they can talk instead of fight. The finale also gives Ultron someone to love. His bond with Jocasta helps him understand Vision. Even so, the show says he is not beyond saving. When he faces his own death, he finally chooses to spare people. In the end, he wants to enjoy human art and maybe even rebuild Jocasta. 'VisionQuest' is now streaming in full on Disney+.
why_it_matters: Stories about villains who can change remind us that people can grow, say sorry, and choose to be kind.
